newsitem.title: CANADA: Goodale says to release CWB barley vote results.
newsitem.headline: Goodale says to release CWB barley vote results.

text.p: Canadian Agriculture Minister Ralph Goodale said on Thursday he plans to release the results of a referendum on the Canadian Wheat Board's barley monopoly by the end of March.
"It (enumeration) will be done by the end of March and I'll release the results then," Goodale told reporters on a conference call from Tokyo.
About 76,000 Prairie farmers were asked to choose one of the two following options:
Open Market Option: Remove all barley from the CWB and place it entirely on the open market for all domestic and export sales, or -
Single-Seller Option: Maintain the CWB as the single-desk seller for all barley with the continuing exception of feed barley which is sold domestically through multiple sellers.
The CWB held an 11 percent share of the world feed barley market in 1994/95 (Aug/July) and 48 percent of the world's malt barley share, exporting 30 percent of Prairie output.
